description: AMBER trained on development scenarios 32, 33 and 34, after scenario 34 was re-downloaded and its unit2 GPS added.
PROVENANCE WARNING: config.json in this directory records epochs=15, which is WRONG. The learning-rate trajectory proves the cosine schedule was sized for 20 epochs: the logged lr at the end of epoch 17 is 5.455e-06, which matches a 20-epoch schedule exactly (5.455e-06) and is impossible for a 15- or 17-epoch one (both give 0). The run completed 17 of 20 epochs, then a later invocation with --epochs 15 and --resume trained nothing (it was already past 15) but overwrote config.json on the way to re-running the final metrics.
note_on_truncation: The schedule did not fully anneal (final lr 5.5e-06 rather than ~0). Immaterial here: the best epoch was 12 and epochs 13-17 did not beat it, so the model had plateaued.
known_result: Scenario 31 collapses on adaptation (Top-1 0.04, DBA 0.156) against 0.85-0.91 elsewhere. Expected, not a bug: scenario 31 has zero training samples and is the only straight-road geometry. Scenarios 32 and 33 on the same split score 0.56 and 0.44, which rules out the split, the preprocessing and the absent beam history as causes.
